answer.rationale: The write path is degraded during peak settlement traffic, so adding capacity directly addresses the active bottleneck and protects customer writes. The release cannot be rolled back because of the mandatory security patch. Read-replica routing would not relieve write pressure, circuit breaking could reject payment work, and regional failover may shift rather than remove the load. Memory b3 supports provisioning headroom during surges; expand capacity broadly while continuing to monitor latency, queue depth, and write success rates.
